scientific_stage: Confirm remote non-adaptive public-I1-compatible candidates before graph composition

selection_rule.purpose: Test the most remote public-I1-compatible points found by non-adaptive coverage, without using graph predictions or white-box outcomes. If fewer than two compatible LHS points exist for a provider, select all available points.

confirmation.reference_ceiling: For each provider, use 1.25 times the best confirmation MSE already frozen in the preceding M2-A confirmation experiment. The ceiling is not recomputed from the new remote candidates.
confirmation.purpose: Determine whether geometrically remote LHS points remain public-I1-compatible after reducing 25-trajectory search noise.

next_gate: Only remote candidates that pass the frozen local confirmation ceiling may enter a subsequent one-at-a-time graph test.
